description: Emergency and critical pattern red-flag rules — conservative, high-sensitivity defaults

rules.name: Possible Acute Coronary Syndrome Pattern
rules.description: Chest pain with features suggestive of acute coronary syndrome

escalationMessage.en: Please wait, a staff member will assist you shortly.
escalationMessage.hi: कृपया प्रतीक्षा करें, एक कर्मचारी जल्द ही आपकी सहायता करेगा।

rules.staffMessage: Patient presents with left/central chest pain of crushing/pressing character — pattern consistent with possible ACS. Requires immediate triage assessment.

rules.name: Chest Pain with Arm Radiation
rules.description: Chest pain radiating to arm — supplementary ACS indicator

escalationMessage.en: Please wait, a staff member will assist you shortly.
escalationMessage.hi: कृपया प्रतीक्षा करें, एक कर्मचारी जल्द ही आपकी सहायता करेगा।

rules.staffMessage: Patient reports chest pain radiating to arm — possible ACS pattern. Immediate triage assessment required.

rules.name: Severe Respiratory Distress
rules.description: Severe shortness of breath as presenting complaint

escalationMessage.en: Please wait, a staff member will assist you shortly.
escalationMessage.hi: कृपया प्रतीक्षा करें, एक कर्मचारी जल्द ही आपकी सहायता करेगा।

rules.staffMessage: Patient reports severe shortness of breath (severity >7/10). Requires immediate assessment.

rules.name: Severe Pain Alert

escalationMessage.en: We've noted your pain level. A staff member will check on you shortly.
escalationMessage.hi: हमने आपके दर्द के स्तर को नोट किया है। एक कर्मचारी जल्द ही आपसे मिलेंगे।

rules.staffMessage: Patient reports severe pain (severity >= 8/10). Please assess promptly.

rules.name: Known Drug Allergy with Active Medication
rules.description: Patient has both a documented allergy and active medications — potential interaction flag

escalationMessage.en: Thank you for sharing your allergy information. The doctor will review this carefully.
escalationMessage.hi: आपकी एलर्जी की जानकारी साझा करने के लिए धन्यवाद। डॉक्टर इसकी सावधानी से समीक्षा करेंगे।

rules.staffMessage: Patient has documented allergies AND is on active medications. Physician should verify no contraindicated medications are being taken.

rules.name: Chest Pain with Dyspnoea
rules.description: Combination of chest pain and shortness of breath

escalationMessage.en: Please wait, a staff member will assist you shortly.
escalationMessage.hi: कृपया प्रतीक्षा करें, एक कर्मचारी जल्द ही आपकी सहायता करेगा।

rules.staffMessage: Patient reports chest pain with associated dyspnoea — multiple differential diagnoses possible including ACS, PE, pneumothorax. Urgent triage required.
